title: Decouple baseline import permission from live trading policy
commands_run: $env:PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX='.pycache_baseline_import_decouple'; python -m py_compile scripts\automation_read_only_runner.py scripts\sync_handoff_to_docs.py app\V2\ui\controls_tab.py app\V2\streamlit_app.py

eth_no_confirm_import_once.warning: live trading disabled, baseline import only

handoff_improvement.change: Added --public-retries and --public-retry-delay so --verify-public waits/retries through GitHub Pages propagation instead of failing immediately on stale public files.

summary: Baseline import permission is now decoupled from enabled_for_live. allow_baseline_import=true is sufficient for baseline import policy while live trading remains disabled; no-confirm ETH import once is blocked only by missing confirmation, with warning 'live trading disabled, baseline import only'. No DB write or live action occurred.
